description: This is a Java test class 'EndpointChecksIT' that performs integration tests on a running BankApp instance over HTTP. It contains multiple test methods to verify health endpoints, API documentation, Swagger UI, and H2 console accessibility, using JUnit 5 and HttpClient.

classes.name: EndpointChecksIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for performing integration tests on the BankApp endpoints. It verifies health, OpenAPI docs, Swagger UI, and H2 console, handling redirects and environment variable configuration.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for the tests, checking the BASE_URL environment variable or defaulting to 'http://localhost:8989/bank-api', trimming trailing slashes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path or URL, with optional Accept header, using the shared HttpClient.

methods.name: isRedirect
methods.description: Checks if a status code indicates an HTTP redirect.

methods.name: followRedirectOnce
methods.description: Follows a single redirect based on the Location header, asserting its presence, and returns the response from the redirected URL.

methods.name: healthzReturnsOkJson
methods.description: Tests that the /healthz endpoint returns HTTP 200 with JSON body {"status":"ok"}.

methods.name: actuatorHealthReportsUpStatus
methods.description: Verifies that /actuator/health returns status UP in JSON.

methods.name: openApiDocsContainOpenApiFieldOrSkipIfSwagger2
methods.description: Checks that /v3/api-docs' response contains 'openapi' field or skips if it's a Swagger 2.x document.

methods.name: swaggerUiIsReachable
methods.description: Ensures the Swagger UI endpoint is reachable and contains 'Swagger UI'.

methods.name: h2ConsoleIsReachable
methods.description: Confirms that the H2 console page is reachable and contains 'H2 Console'.
